title: Descent of the length of virtual good reduction
as_he_states: For a BT pro-ℓ group with virtual good reduction and potential length≤n, obtain length≤n over the original henselian trait.

P78-C071 supplies a complete present-run deduction for finite K/Q_p,p>2 integrally, using Fontaine1994VIII, Breuil2000 Theorem5.3.2/Corollary5.3.4 and Raynaud1974 §2.1/Proposition2.3.1. The rational argument works every p. No full arbitrary-trait solution was identified by the exact search; absence of such identification is not modern openness.

worth: Worth completing a precise p=2 or broader-trait literature-to-proof bridge; do not repeat the finite-K,p>2 argument already supplied here.
